name: Datura + Rhubarb + Ginger
indication_description:
This tablet is indicated in-
  • Pyrexia
  • Dyspnoea
  • Pain
  • Exhaustion
  • Convulsion due to excessive bile
pharmacology_description: This is a very effective preparation of Datura (Datura stramonium), Ginger (Zingiber officinale) and other ingredients. It is very effective in pyrexia and dyspnoea. This also acts as an analgesic.
dosage_description: 1-2 tablet(s) twice daily or as prescribed by the physicians.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Protect from light. Keep in cool & dry place.
